diggs:SpecificationRegistry.gml:description: Canonical citations of the published standards, codes, recommendations, test methods, agency special provisions and research reports cited across DIGGS practice. A data provider cites an entry by xlink:href from a property typed diggs:SpecificationPropertyType - normally diggs:RIProgramBasis/governingStandard, but also diggs:AbstractTestProcedureType/testProcedureMethod, diggs:AbstractSpecimenType/preparationProcedure and any other Specification-typed property - rather than retyping the standard's bibliographic detail. The href targets the diggs:Specification's gml:id, so it resolves to exactly the kind of object an instance would otherwise have carried inline; the enclosing diggs:SpecificationRegistryEntry carries the registration metadata, and its occurrences declare where the entry may legitimately be cited. One registry serves every domain of practice - see diggs:SpecificationRegistry's own schema documentation for why a per-domain split was tried and withdrawn - and each entry's domain element (coded against specificationDomain.xml) classifies which domain(s) cite it, so the registry stays browsable and filterable by practice area without being split into several files. Populated first for rigid inclusions, derived from the 'Required by (source)' column of the DIGGS rigid inclusions technical report, which populates it on all 235 essential parameters; laboratory testing, in-situ testing, sampling and construction domains are added as entries under the same registry rather than as separate documents.
diggs:SpecificationRegistry.gml:name: DIGGS Specification Registry

diggs:Specification.gml:description: French national research project recommendations for rigid inclusion ground improvement. Source of the Domain 1 / Domain 2 reinforcement distinction and of the settlement efficacy definition (Eq 2.23, p. 79).
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASIRI National Project Recommendations (2012)
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Recommendations for the design, construction and control of rigid inclusion ground improvements

diggs:Specification.gml:description: British code of practice covering basal reinforcement over piled embankments, including the requirement that reinforcement carry at least 15 percent of the load.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: BS 8006-1:2010+A1:2016
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Code of practice for strengthened/reinforced soils and other fills

diggs:Specification.gml:description: German recommendations for geosynthetic-reinforced earth structures. Source of the Zaeske arching model and of the Winkler subgrade reaction treatment of load transfer.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: EBGEO (2011)
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Recommendations for design and analysis of earth structures using geosynthetic reinforcements

diggs:Specification.gml:description: US Federal Highway Administration reference manual for ground modification. Source of the generalized parabolic and beam methods, the stress-reduction ratio and the membrane factor of Table 6-2.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: FHWA GEC-13 (FHWA-NHI-16-028)
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Geotechnical Engineering Circular No. 13: Ground Modification Methods Reference Manual

diggs:Specification.gml:description: European standard for geotechnical design. Source of the Design Approach safety formats and of the consequence class framework.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: Eurocode 7 - EN 1997
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Eurocode 7: Geotechnical design

diggs:Specification.gml:description: European execution standard for displacement piles, covering the installation technique families used for rigid inclusions.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: EN 12699:2015
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Execution of special geotechnical works - Displacement piles

diggs:Specification.gml:description: European execution standard for deep mixing, covering soil-mixed columns and soil-mixed load transfer platforms.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: EN 14679
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Execution of special geotechnical works - Deep mixing

diggs:Specification.gml:description: French unified technical document for the design and execution of ground-bearing concrete slabs, commonly the supported structure over a rigid inclusion treated area.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: DTU 13.3
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Dallages - Conception, calcul et execution (concrete ground-bearing slabs)

diggs:Specification.gml:description: US model building code chapter governing soils and foundations, including the seismic site class framework.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: IBC 2024 Chapter 18
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: International Building Code, Chapter 18: Soils and Foundations

diggs:Specification.gml:description: French national application document to Eurocode 7 for shallow foundations.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: NF P94-261
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Justification des ouvrages geotechniques - Fondations superficielles

diggs:Specification.gml:description: French national application document to Eurocode 7 for deep foundations. Governs the verification of Domain 1 inclusions as deep foundations.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: NF P94-262
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Justification des ouvrages geotechniques - Fondations profondes

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Dutch design guideline for piled embankments. Source of the Concentric Arches load transfer model; ranked among the more accurate methods by Han et al. (2025).
diggs:Specification.gml:name: CUR 226
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Ontwerprichtlijn paalmatrassystemen (Design guideline for piled embankments)

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Static axial compressive load testing of deep foundations, applied to rigid inclusion trial and production columns.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D1143
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Methods for Deep Foundations Under Static Axial Compressive Load

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Low strain impact integrity testing, the basis of the low-strain integrity verification of rigid inclusion columns. Withdrawn by ASTM in 2025 with no replacement named; a reinstatement effort (ASTM work item WK93548) is in progress. Retained and citable for the same reason ASTM D1194 is - the workbook, the industry, and instances published before and after the withdrawal all mean this standard by "PIT"/low-strain integrity testing.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D5882 (withdrawn)
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Method for Low Strain Impact Integrity Testing of Deep Foundations

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Rapid (force pulse) load testing of deep foundations.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D7383
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Methods for Axial Compressive Force Pulse (Rapid) Testing of Deep Foundations

diggs:Specification.gml:description: High-strain dynamic testing of deep foundations.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D4945
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Method for High-Strain Dynamic Testing of Deep Foundations

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Static axial compressive load testing of piles by the maintained-load method, the current European counterpart to ASTM D1143 for the same test - the standard most ASIRI-governed European rigid inclusion projects cite for a static load test, superseding the withdrawn NF P94-150-1 that ASIRI (2012) itself was written against.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: EN ISO 22477-1
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Geotechnical investigation and testing - Testing of geotechnical structures - Part 1: Testing of piles: static compression load testing

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Rapid (force-pulse) axial compressive load testing of piles, the European counterpart to ASTM D7383 for the same test.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: EN ISO 22477-10
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Geotechnical investigation and testing - Testing of geotechnical structures - Part 10: Testing of piles: rapid load testing

diggs:Specification.gml:description: High-strain dynamic load testing of piles, the European counterpart to ASTM D4945 for the base impact-testing method, and broader in scope - it also covers driving-formula, wave-equation and multi-blow dynamic testing under the same standard number.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: EN ISO 22477-4
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Geotechnical investigation and testing - Testing of geotechnical structures - Part 4: Dynamic load testing of piles

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Tensile testing of geogrids, the source of the characteristic tensile strength used in load transfer platform reinforcement design.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D6637
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Method for Determining Tensile Properties of Geogrids by the Single or Multi-Rib Tensile Method

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Nonrepetitive static plate load testing, used for plate bearing verification over a treated area.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D1196
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Method for Nonrepetitive Static Plate Load Tests of Soils and Flexible Pavement Components

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Withdrawn ASTM method for static plate load testing of spread footings. Retained because instances published while it was current cite it; use ASTM D1196 for new work.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D1194 (withdrawn)
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Method for Bearing Capacity of Soil for Static Load and Spread Footings

diggs:Specification.gml:description: The German static plate load test - the third tradition alongside ASTM D1195/D1196 for the same test class, distinct in prescribing exactly two load cycles and reporting two named deformation moduli (Ev1, Ev2) whose ratio indicates degree of compaction.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: DIN 18134
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Baugrund - Untersuchung von Bodenproben - Bestimmung des Verformungsmoduls und des Verformungsmoduls durch Plattendruckversuche (Soil - Testing procedures and testing equipment - Plate load test)

diggs:Specification.gml:description: USCS soil classification. Registered as a citable governing document; the classification values themselves are controlled by the astmD2487 code list.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D2487
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Practice for Classification of Soils for Engineering Purposes (Unified Soil Classification System)

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Visual-manual soil description. Registered as a citable governing document; the description values themselves are controlled by the astmD2488 code list.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D2488
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Practice for Description and Identification of Soils (Visual-Manual Procedures)

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Menard pressuremeter testing, the source of the pressuremeter modulus and limit pressure used in French rigid inclusion design practice.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ISO 22476-4
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Geotechnical investigation and testing - Field testing - Part 4: Menard pressuremeter test

diggs:Specification.gml:description: State agency special provision specifying permitted inclusion types and acceptance requirements.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: KDOT special provision
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Kansas Department of Transportation special provision for rigid inclusions / column-supported embankments

diggs:Specification.gml:description: State agency special provision specifying permitted inclusion types, instrumentation and acceptance requirements.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: MnDOT special provision
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Minnesota Department of Transportation special provision for rigid inclusions / column-supported embankments

diggs:Specification.gml:description: State agency special provision specifying permitted inclusion types and acceptance requirements.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: IaDOT special provision
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Iowa Department of Transportation special provision for rigid inclusions / column-supported embankments

diggs:Specification.gml:description: State agency special provision specifying permitted inclusion types and acceptance requirements.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: PennDOT special provision
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Pennsylvania Department of Transportation special provision for rigid inclusions / column-supported embankments

diggs:Specification.gml:description: US national cooperative highway research program project developing AASHTO specifications for column-supported embankments.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: NCHRP 10-121
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Proposed AASHTO specifications and commentary for column-supported embankments

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Deep Foundations Institute publication on rigid inclusion practice; source of the seismic site class commentary.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: DFI - Smith et al. (2023a)
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Deep Foundations Institute guidance on rigid inclusions (Smith et al., 2023a)

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Companion Deep Foundations Institute publication on rigid inclusion practice.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: DFI - Smith et al. (2023b)
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Deep Foundations Institute guidance on rigid inclusions (Smith et al., 2023b)

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Comparative evaluation of column-supported embankment design methods; source of the accuracy ranking that places CUR 226 among the more accurate methods.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: Han et al. (2025) - FHWA-KS-25-02
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Evaluation of design methods for column-supported embankments (Han et al., 2025)

diggs:Specification.gml:description: French national standard for the reflection (sonic-echo) method of low-strain foundation-element integrity auscultation - the French-tradition counterpart to ASTM D5882's Pulse Echo Method, registered as its own separate standard rather than one method choice within a wider document.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: NF P94-160-2
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Sols : reconnaissance et essais - Auscultation d'un element de fondation - Partie 2 : methode par reflexion

diggs:Specification.gml:description: French national standard for the impedance method of low-strain foundation-element integrity auscultation - the French-tradition counterpart to ASTM D5882's Transient Response Method, registered as its own separate standard rather than one method choice within a wider document.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: NF P94-160-4
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Sols : reconnaissance et essais - Auscultation d'un element de fondation - Partie 4 : methode par impedance

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Thermal integrity profiling of cast-in-place concrete deep foundation elements, relating the heat of hydration generated by curing concrete to as-built cross-section and continuity. Withdrawn 2023, reinstated 2025 as D7949-25 under a broader title ("Integrity Testing of Concrete Deep Foundations by Thermal Methods") that drops the original edition's "Thermal Integrity Profiling" branding and adds a third measurement method (embedded fiber-optic cable). No European or ISO counterpart exists - checked, not assumed; EN 1536/EN 1538 recognise the technique but do not define a competing method of their own.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D7949
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Methods for Integrity Testing of Concrete Deep Foundations by Thermal Methods

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Static lateral (transverse) load-deflection testing of deep foundation elements or groups, applicable regardless of installation method. Current, not withdrawn.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D3966/D3966M
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Methods for Deep Foundation Elements Under Static Lateral Load

diggs:Specification.gml:description: French national standard for static lateral (transverse) load testing of an isolated pile - the French-tradition counterpart to ASTM D3966/D3966M. Current, not withdrawn.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: NF P94-151
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Sols : reconnaissance et essais - Essai statique de pieu isole sous effort transversal

diggs:Specification.gml:description: The Standard Penetration Test. Drives a split-barrel sampler with a 63.5 kg hammer falling 760 mm and reports the blow count over the 150-450 mm interval as the N value, recovering a disturbed sample for identification at the same time; it is therefore both an in-situ test method and a sampling method. Cited by the Jazera Royal Palace substation investigation as ASTM D-1586-2011.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D1586/D1586M
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Method for Standard Penetration Test (SPT) and Split-Barrel Sampling of Soils

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Particle-size distribution by sieving above 75 micrometres and by hydrometer sedimentation below it. Withdrawn by ASTM in 2016 with no direct one-to-one replacement; the successor methods are ASTM D6913/D6913M for sieve analysis and ASTM D7928 for sedimentation. Registered because it remains widely cited by projects in progress, including the Jazera Royal Palace substation investigation.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D422
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Method for Particle-Size Analysis of Soils

diggs:Specification.gml:description: The Atterberg limits. Determines liquid limit by Casagrande cup (multipoint Method A or one-point Method B), plastic limit by thread rolling, and plasticity index as their difference. Withdrawn by ASTM in 2026; registered because it is cited by projects in progress and is the basis of the plasticity input to ASTM D2487 classification.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D4318
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Methods for Liquid Limit, Plastic Limit, and Plasticity Index of Soils

diggs:Specification.gml:description: The modified Proctor compaction test. Establishes the relationship between water content and dry unit weight using a 4.54 kg rammer dropped 457 mm, giving maximum dry density and optimum moisture content. Method C, used at Jazera, compacts five layers of 56 blows in a 152 mm mould.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D1557
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Methods for Laboratory Compaction Characteristics of Soil Using Modified Effort (56,000 ft-lbf/ft3 (2,700 kN-m/m3))

diggs:Specification.gml:description: The California Bearing Ratio of laboratory-compacted subgrade, subbase and base course materials, reported as a percentage of the load on a standard crushed-stone reference at 2.54 and 5.08 mm penetration. Normally run on specimens compacted at several efforts (10, 25 and 56 blows per layer) so CBR can be interpolated at a specified percentage of maximum dry density, and optionally soaked to record swell.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D1883
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Method for California Bearing Ratio (CBR) of Laboratory-Compacted Soils

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Maximum index dry density of cohesionless, free-draining soils using a vertically vibrating table. Used with ASTM D4254 to compute relative density, which the Jazera investigation specifies as the acceptance basis for granular backfill. Withdrawn by ASTM in 2025.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D4253
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Methods for Maximum Index Density and Unit Weight of Soils Using a Vibratory Table

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Minimum index dry density of cohesionless, free-draining soils, and the calculation of relative density from it together with the maximum index density of ASTM D4253. Withdrawn by ASTM in 2025; a reinstatement work item (WK99698) was open at the time of registration.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D4254
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Methods for Minimum Index Density and Unit Weight of Soils and Calculation of Relative Density

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Chemical and electro-chemical test methods for soil, weak rock and groundwater, covering pH, sulfate, chloride, carbonate, organic matter and electrical resistivity. Used to assess ground aggressiveness towards buried concrete and steel. The Jazera Royal Palace substation investigation cites it for pH, sulfate, chloride and magnesium determinations.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: BS 1377-3
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Methods of test for soils for civil engineering purposes. Chemical and electro-chemical testing

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Soil electrical resistivity by the Wenner four-electrode array: a current is driven between the outer electrodes and the potential drop measured between the inner pair, with the electrode spacing controlling the depth of investigation. Covers both in-situ measurement and measurement on samples removed from the ground in a soil box. Results support corrosion assessment and earthing design, and are commonly classified for soil corrosivity.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM G57
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Method for Measurement of Soil Resistivity Using the Wenner Four-Electrode Method

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Practical test methods for the electrical characteristics of grounding systems, including earth resistivity measurement, power-frequency and transient ground impedance to remote earth, touch and step voltages, and grounding-system integrity. Cited alongside ASTM G57 for the four-electrode resistivity surveys in the Jazera Royal Palace substation investigation.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: IEEE Std 81
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: IEEE Guide for Measuring Earth Resistivity, Ground Impedance, and Earth Surface Potentials of a Grounding System

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Thermal conductivity of soil and rock by the transient thermal needle probe: a line heat source is energised and the rate of temperature rise is interpreted for the thermal constants of the surrounding medium. Applicable to intact and reconstituted specimens and effective both in the laboratory and in the field. Thermal resistivity is reported as its reciprocal.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D5334
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Method for Determination of Thermal Conductivity of Soil and Rock by Thermal Needle Probe Procedure

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Thermal resistivity measurement of soils and of backfill materials used to encase buried cable systems, including concrete, engineered backfill, grout, rock and sand. Describes probe designs for both laboratory and field use and rests on the same line heat source theory as ASTM D5334. Underpins the ampacity rating of underground cable circuits.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: IEEE Std 442-2017
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: IEEE Guide for Thermal Resistivity Measurements of Soils and Backfill Materials

diggs:Specification.gml:description: The loading code of the Saudi Building Code. Chapter 11 sets the seismic design criteria and mapped ground motion values, Chapter 20 the site classification procedure and site class definitions, and Chapter 22 the seismic ground motion maps. It is the source of the Ss, S1, site class, Fa and Fv values reported for the Jazera Royal Palace substation site.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: SBC 301-CR-18
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: The Saudi Loading Code, Code Requirements

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Saudi Electricity Company material standard specification for normal-weight ready-mixed Portland cement concrete on SEC projects, covering mix design, constituent materials, quality control, delivery and testing, with strength and durability requirements keyed to exposure condition. The Jazera Royal Palace substation report tabulates its concrete requirements for very severe exposure. Bibliographic detail is taken from the citing project report and secondary sources; the controlled document was not publicly retrievable at the time of registration.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: 70-TMSS-03
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Technical Material Standard Specification - Normal weight ready-mixed Portland cement concrete
